description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5945008407844 RELAY,ROTARY: Line 0001 Qty 87 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0105 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 13. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 03956 15A5129-1; 07309 E014CK11177PC24PC32PC33; 63743 106.416-3; 77342 MDR135-1. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice.
